title: Singular genitive: -i becomes -e-
focus: Change final -i to -e- before -n in these older words: ovi (“door”) → oven.

exercises.prompt: Choose the singular genitive of ovi (“door”).
exercises.explanation: Change final i to e: ovi → ove-; add -n to get oven.

optionFeedback.oven: Change final i to e: ovi → ove-; add -n to get oven.
optionFeedback.ovi: ovi is the dictionary form; this question needs the singular genitive.
optionFeedback.ovin: ovin does not use the singular genitive stem and ending for ovi.
